title: Revision of the 1990 Working Formulation for the Standardization of Nomenclature in the Diagnosis of Heart Rejection
venue: Journal of Heart and Lung Transplantation
study_context: ISHLT consensus revision of cardiac allograft biopsy rejection nomenclature.
population_or_data: Consensus grading criteria and illustrative endomyocardial biopsy histology.
task: Define standardized acute cellular rejection grades and non-rejection mimics.
method: Multidisciplinary consensus review approved by the ISHLT Board.
main_findings: The revised acute cellular rejection scale uses grades 0R, 1R, 2R, and 3R.
The criteria distinguish mild, moderate, and severe rejection by infiltrate distribution and myocyte damage.
limitations: A consensus nomenclature is not a validation study of a machine-learning endpoint or threshold.
does_not_establish: It does not establish that a binary rejection target is clinically optimal for this project.
relevance_to_project: Canonical source for mapping labels and auditing grade collapsing in cardiac allograft WSI experiments.
